summary.text: Gina Curry is a Democratic state representative who has represented Pennsylvania House of Representatives District 164 since December 13, 2021 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
Her career experience includes work as a training consultant, clinical supervisor and behavioral specialist.

paragraphs.text: Gina Curry graduated from the Institute of Notre Dame in 1990 and earned bachelor's and master's degrees in criminal justice from Saint Joseph's University in 1994 and 1996.
Her career experience includes working as a training consultant, clinical supervisor and behavioral specialist, and she previously held an at-large seat on the Upper Darby School District board.

Curry took office in the state House in December 2021 and was assigned in the 2023-2024 session to the Appropriations, Children and Youth, Education and Transportation committees, with a subcommittee chair on railroads.
